lineage.first: First version of a new set

edit.title: Edit {{ref}}
edit.intro: Changes are saved on the hub only. The author's router keeps its own copy, and the catalogue is signed by this hub once the version is approved.
edit.domainsHint: Entries: {{count}}, one per line. A plain entry matches the domain and every subdomain; b4 has no wildcard syntax.
edit.ipsHint: Entries: {{count}}, one per line. IP addresses and CIDR ranges; commas and spaces also separate entries.
edit.asnsHint: Entries: {{count}}, one per line, as AS13335 or 13335.
edit.geositeHint: Entries: {{count}}. Each router looks them up in its own geosite file.
edit.geoipHint: Entries: {{count}}. Each router looks them up in its own GeoIP file.
edit.filterUnknown: b4 does not know this value, so the set matches nothing
edit.domainOnlyHint: Match the domains only by the name in the handshake, never by their IP address.
edit.targetsLocked: The full set JSON is not valid, so the target fields are locked: {{message}}
edit.noTargets: The set has no targets. Add a domain, an address, an ASN or a category: a set without targets cannot be saved.
edit.jsonHint: Everything the set carries. Fields outside the shareable allow-list are dropped by the check.
edit.notObject: The set must be a JSON object
edit.stale: The content changed since the last check. Check again before saving.
edit.unchanged: Nothing differs from the current version.
edit.targetsOnly: Only targets, title or description differ. The strategy fingerprint stays the same, so existing votes still count.
edit.fpChanged: The strategy differs from what the author sent. The fingerprint changes, the votes recorded for this version are dropped, and the published set will no longer match the author's own copy.
edit.duplicate: The result duplicates {{ref}} ({{title}}, {{status}}). Saving is refused.
edit.b4MinChanged: After this change the version needs b4 {{to}} or newer; until now it needed {{from}}.

suggestion.deadWildcardCovered: {{entry}} never matches anything: b4 has no wildcard syntax, and {{by}} already covers every subdomain.
suggestion.deadWildcardReplace: {{entry}} never matches anything: b4 has no wildcard syntax. Replace it with {{replacement}}.
suggestion.deadWildcard: {{entry}} never matches anything: b4 has no wildcard syntax.
suggestion.wwwOnly: {{entry}} is listed but {{replacement}} is not. {{replacement}} would cover the domain and every subdomain.

edit.diffSame: The set JSON stays as it is.
edit.diffNone: The set is identical to what was received.

sets.withdrawText: The whole set leaves the catalogue at the next build. Versions keep their states, so reinstating brings back exactly what was listed. Its open reports are marked handled.
sets.reinstateText: The set is listed again at the next build, as it was before it was withdrawn.
sets.authorBannedBanner: The author is banned. Nothing of this set is listed until the ban is lifted.
sets.listedBanner: Listed in the catalogue as v{{version}}.
sets.notListedBanner: Not listed: no version of this set is active.

entry.decodeErrorValue: the stored set does not decode with this hub's b4 version

detail.noVotes: No vote has been recorded for this set.
detail.deleteHint: Removes the set with every version, its votes, reports and payloads no other set uses. Hiding is enough to take it out of the catalogue; deletion is for entries that should never have existed.
detail.deleteText: This cannot be undone. Routers that applied the set keep their local copy but lose the link.
detail.heading: Set

keys.title: Keys ({{count}})
keys.empty: No key has been seen yet.
keys.searchPlaceholder: Key prefix, router key id, name or note
keys.banText: New records from this key are refused. At the next build its sets leave the catalogue and its votes and reports stop counting. Nothing is deleted: unbanning restores everything.
keys.trustText: A trusted key is exempt from the per-key daily limits on shares, votes, reports and mirror announcements. Its records still go through moderation.
keys.unbanText: The key can send records again. At the next build its sets return and its votes count again.
keys.untrustText: The key falls back under the per-key daily limits.

ban.listed: Listed sets that leave the catalogue: {{count}}
ban.pending: Pending shares that can no longer be approved without an override: {{count}}
ban.votes: Votes that stop counting: {{count}}, on strategies: {{sets}}
ban.reports: Open reports that stop counting toward the automatic hide: {{count}}

unban.listed: Sets that return to the catalogue: {{count}}
unban.votes: Votes that count again: {{count}}, on strategies: {{sets}}

impact.mirrors: Mirrors announced by this key: {{count}}. A ban does not stop announcing them; reject them on the Mirrors page for that.

tags.staffHelp: A router of your own. Only a label: its votes count like any other.
tags.testHelp: A test router. Its votes do not count in published scores and its reports do not count toward the automatic hide.
tags.testOn: Its votes stop counting in published scores at the next build.
tags.testOff: Its votes count again in published scores at the next build.

keys.matchedByKeyId: Found by the router key id: the hub stores only its HMAC.
keys.votesTip: Manual votes: {{manual}}; automatic votes from its own shares: {{uploads}}

mirrors.rejectText: A rejected mirror stays in the list with its reason and is never announced to routers.
mirrors.removeText: The mirror is forgotten. It can announce itself again.
mirrors.approveText: A health check runs right away; the mirror is announced to routers once it passes.

announced.kept: kept while no mirror passes its check
announced.waiting: joins after its next passing check

mirrors.dropsAt: drops out at {{when}} without a passing check

feedback.votesHint: Every vote with the weight the last published build gave it. Votes pool by strategy fingerprint, so one vote can count toward several listed sets.
feedback.authorVote: The set's author voted on their own set.

reason.test: the key is tagged as a test key

catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.actionsDesc: Published by a background build; each run is listed in the build history below
catalogue.buildText: Queues a build that publishes the catalogue from the store even when nothing changed.
catalogue.epochText: Resets the sequence. Routers treat the new epoch as authoritative and drop anything from the old one. Use after restoring the database from a backup.
catalogue.epochConfirm: Start a new epoch? Every router will re-download the catalogue.
catalogue.revokeText: Adds an ed25519 hub signing key to the revoked list carried by every manifest. Routers stop trusting anything signed by it. This is unrelated to router keys on the Keys page.
catalogue.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{key}}? This cannot be undone from the console.
catalogue.revokeForever: Routers keep every revocation forever. Removing it from the hub later does not undo it.
catalogue.revokeBuiltin: This key is built into b4. Revoking it cuts off every router that trusts the built-in key.
catalogue.revokeBuiltinAllow: I understand, revoke the built-in key

history.title: Build history
history.desc: What each build changed in the catalogue
history.empty: No build has been recorded yet.

settings.limitsDesc: How much one contributor may send
settings.limitsText: Per-key limits count records signed by one router key; per-network limits count by the sender's /24 (IPv6: /48). Changes apply to the next request; counters already spent today are kept.
settings.notesWindow: A day is the UTC calendar day and an hour is the clock hour, so a limit reached at 22:00 UTC clears at midnight. Counters live in memory and start over when the service restarts.
settings.notesTrusted: A key marked as trusted on the Keys page skips every per-key limit. Per-network limits still apply to it.
settings.notesRefund: A record the hub rejects, or a share that turns out to duplicate an existing set, does not spend the key's quota. Only accepted records count.

errors.own_key: This is the key this hub signs with. Revoking it would make every router reject this hub.

errors.too_many: Too many items at once, at most {{max}}.
errors.not_pending: Only a pending version can be edited.

errors.bad_chat_id: The chat id must be a number or an @channel name.

approve.title: Approve {{title}}
approve.text: The version becomes active. The catalogue is rebuilt in the background right away.

reject.title: Reject {{title}}
reject.text: The reason stays on the hub and is shown only in this console; routers do not receive it.

hide.title: Hide {{title}}
hide.text: A hidden version stays on the hub and can be restored. Later shares of the same strategy count as duplicates of it.

restore.title: Restore {{title}}
restore.text: The version returns to the state it was hidden from. Its open reports are dismissed, so the automatic hide starts counting from zero.

effect.none: No catalogue change: the set is not listed before or after.
effect.unchanged: No catalogue change: v{{version}} stays listed.
effect.leaves: The set leaves the catalogue: v{{version}} is no longer listed and nothing replaces it.
effect.replaces: v{{version}} is listed instead of v{{previous}}.

withheld.set_withdrawn: The set is withdrawn, so nothing of it is listed.
withheld.author_banned: The author is banned, so nothing of the set is listed.

effect.reportsDismissed: Open reports that will be dismissed: {{count}}
effect.reportsResolved: Open reports that will be marked handled: {{count}}

force.author_banned: Approve anyway; the version stays out of the catalogue while the author is banned
force.set_withdrawn: Approve anyway; the version stays out of the catalogue while the set is withdrawn

moderation.withdrawToo: Also withdraw the whole set, so no other version is listed instead
moderation.reasonHint: Stored on the hub, never sent to routers.

reports.countingHint: Open reports with a known network from keys that are neither banned nor tagged test. Three reports from independent keys and networks hide a listed version automatically.
reports.inboxHint: Dismiss a report that is unfounded; mark it handled once you acted on it. Only open reports count toward the automatic hide.

version.dismissText: Open reports: {{count}}. Dismissed reports stop counting toward the automatic hide.
version.resolveTitle: Mark the open reports of {{ref}} as handled
version.resolveText: Open reports: {{count}}. Handled reports stop counting toward the automatic hide.

similar.title: Similar sets: {{count}}
similar.truncated: Only the closest matches are shown.
similar.failed: Similar sets could not be checked: {{message}}

bulk.someRefused: {{valid}} of {{total}} can be changed; the rest are skipped.

card.unreadable: This set does not decode with the hub's b4 version, so its settings are not shown.
card.bannedTip: The author is banned. Nothing of this set is listed until the ban is lifted.
card.withdrawnTip: A moderator withdrew the whole set. Nothing of it is listed until it is reinstated.

low_score.label: low score
low_score.hint: At least 3 weighted votes and a score under 30%. Routers still list it; this is a console signal.

stale.label: stale
stale.hint: No vote for 60 days and almost no remaining weight. Routers still list it.

weak.label: under 50%
weak.hint: Enough independent votes to show a score, and the score is under 50%.

reports.label: open reports
reports.hint: The listed version has open reports.

score.unratedTip: Routers show a score once at least two devices voted.

evidence.authorTip: The author's own: +{{works}} / -{{broken}}, counted like any other device
evidence.pooledTip: The score pools votes by strategy fingerprint; {{count}} other sets share it

passthrough.text: no bypass, matched traffic passes unchanged

needs_payload.label: needs payload
needs_payload.hint: The set carries payload files the router downloads with it.

block.label: blocks traffic
block.hint: A block set drops matched traffic instead of bypassing DPI.

has_pins.label: pins addresses
has_pins.hint: The set pins domains to fixed addresses in DNS.

blanket.label: categories only
blanket.hint: No domains or addresses, only geosite categories. A router can match it only if its own geosite file has those categories.

catch_all.label: pattern match
catch_all.hint: At least one domain entry is a regular expression.

audit.batchHint: Part of a bulk action. Click to show the whole batch.

emitted.unreadable: (custom payload without a readable server name)

editText.title: Edit the text of {{ref}}
editText.intro: Only the title and description change. The strategy, targets and version stay the same.
editText.introListed: Only the title and description change, so routers see no update and votes keep counting. Routers that already applied the set keep their local name; new ones get the new title after the next build.

mirror.hint: A mirror that announced itself and waits for approval

notify.digestHint: The first event after a quiet period goes out at once, later ones are grouped into at most one message per interval. From {{min}} to {{max}}.
notify.testKeysHint: Shares and reports from keys tagged test are not sent. Enabling a channel or an event does not replay what arrived before.
notify.stored: Stored. Type a new value to replace it.
